text: Applied economics is a discipline within the field of economics that focuses on solving practical economic problems. It builds upon the theoretical framework of economics (such as supply and demand theory, marginal effect, etc.), converting abstract economic principles into operational analytical tools and solutions, and is widely applied in real scenarios such as government decision-making, enterprise operations, and financial markets. From individual investment choices to national industrial planning, from the formulation of international trade rules to regional economic coordinated development, applied economics always conducts research centered around "how to use data and models to answer the 'what, why, and how' questions in economic practice."
